subcommands.console: Try Terraform expressions at an interactive command prompt
subcommands.fmt: Reformat your configuration in the standard style
subcommands.force-unlock: Release a stuck lock on the current workspace
subcommands.get: Install or upgrade remote Terraform modules
subcommands.import: Associate existing infrastructure with a Terraform resource
subcommands.init: Prepare your working directory for other commands
subcommands.output: Show output values from your root module
subcommands.plan: Show changes required by the current configuration
subcommands.providers: Show the providers required for this configuration
subcommands.refresh: Update the state to match remote systems
subcommands.show: Show the current state or a saved plan
subcommands.taint: Mark a resource instance as not fully functional
subcommands.test: Execute integration tests for Terraform modules
subcommands.untaint: Remove the 'tainted' state from a resource instance
subcommands.validate: Check whether the configuration is valid
